description: HAProxy config security audit — Offline security audit of a haproxy.cfg: runtime API (stats socket) exposed on the network or world-writable, stats page without auth / weak password / admin mode, old TLS versions and weak ciphers, small DH params, plain HTTP without HTTPS redirect, missing HSTS, missing timeouts (slowloris), databases published on all interfaces in tcp mode, backend TLS with verify none, plaintext userlist passwords, Authorization/Cookie captured into logs, running as root, no chroot/maxconn/logging, duplicate sections. Verdict PASS / REVIEW / FIX BEFORE DEPLOY / BLOCK with score, grade, line numbers, fixes and a hardened example. Secrets are never echoed. Params: text= (config) or url= (raw file or GitHub blob link). Example: /v1/security/haproxy-check?url=https://example.com/haproxy.cfg Price: $0.006 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: security_haproxy_check
